mcp_tools.name: localization_readiness_review
mcp_tools.title: Localization readiness review
mcp_tools.description: Submits a localization readiness record (externalized strings and translation units, locale formats plurals and grammar, flexible layout and RTL readiness, content workflow and glossary, locale testing and red lines) and returns a deterministic LOCALIZATION_READINESS_SOUND / LOCALIZATION_READINESS_NOT_SOUND / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE verdict across five sections, including computed per-locale format-test, direction and screenshot coverage checks, with per-check evidence. Audits the declared record; it inspects no code and runs no tests.

inputSchema.description: The localization readiness review manifest (see the atom's SERVICE.md for the field table and row schemas).

product.description: Product or property the review covers.

locales.description: Declared locales: {name, code, direction, format_tests_passed, screenshots_reviewed}.

expect.notes: All boolean flags set to pass, single valid locale provided. computed_spot_checks: locales_count=1, format_test_coverage=1.000000
